name: Topographic & Boundary Survey
notes: Establish OS grid coordinates, boundary pegs, site datum TBM

name: Ground Investigation & Borehole Drilling
notes: 6 boreholes to 12m, 3 trial pits, lab analysis for bearing capacity

name: Demolition of Existing Structures
resources: Excavator with Demolition Attachment, Skip Lorries
notes: Demolish 2 derelict agricultural outbuildings, remove foundations

name: Temporary Site Hoarding & Security
notes: 2.4m hoarding with security lighting, welfare unit, site office

name: Temporary Services & Site Setup
notes: Temporary 3-phase power, water supply, sewage settlement tank

name: Ecology Survey & Tree Protection
output_elements: Ecological Survey Report, Tree Protection Order Plan
notes: Phase 1 habitat survey, bat/bird surveys, TPO compliance plan

name: Building Regulations Approval & Notifications
notes: Full Plans submission to Local Authority Building Control

name: Bulk Excavation to Formation Level
notes: Cut to 1.8m formation level, cart spoil off-site, stockpile retained material

name: Sheet Piling — Perimeter Retention
notes: 100m perimeter sheet pile wall, 8m depth, tie-back anchors at 4m centres

name: Reduced Level Excavation & Trimming
notes: Hand trim to 300mm of formation, proof roll with vibrating roller

name: Reinforcement Cage Fabrication & Fix — Pad Foundations
notes: 24 pad foundations, H20@150 BRC, 75mm blinding, Visqueen DPM

name: Concrete Pour — Pad Foundations
notes: C32/40 XC2, 24 pads, pump pour, vibrate, cure 7 days minimum

name: Drainage — Below Ground Foul & Surface Water
notes: Foul drain to adopted sewer, surface water to attenuation tank

name: Ground Beams — Reinforcement & Formwork
notes: Ring and tie beams linking pad foundations, formwork strike 3 days

name: Concrete Pour — Ground Beams
notes: C32/40 ground beams, continuous pour, curing compound applied

name: Hardcore Fill & Ground Floor Slab Preparation
notes: 300mm Type 1 MOT compacted in 150mm layers, 50mm sand blinding, Visqueen

name: Ground Floor Slab — Reinforcement, Pour & Cure
input_materials: B500A Mesh A393, C28/35 Concrete, Fibres
notes: 200mm RC slab, A393 mesh, 25mm cover, power float finish, 28-day cure

name: Structural Steelwork — Erection
resources: Mobile Crane (50T), Bolt Torque Wrenches, MEWP
input_materials: Grade S355 UB/UC Sections, HSFG Bolts
notes: 4-storey primary steel frame, 24 columns, 3 floor plates, HSFG bolt connections

name: Precast Concrete Floor Planks — Supply & Install
notes: 200mm hollowcore planks, 75mm structural screed topping, grouted joints

name: Structural Screed Topping — Floors 1-3
notes: 75mm bonded screed over hollowcore, B503 mesh, pump applied

name: Masonry — External Cavity Walls
input_materials: Buff Facing Brick, Dense Concrete Block, Ties, DPC
notes: 102mm facing brick / 100mm block cavity wall, 100mm PIR insulation, wall ties

name: Roof Structure — Timber Trusses & Decking
input_materials: C24 Trussed Rafters, OSB3 Decking, Ridge Board
notes: Prefabricated attic trusses at 600c/c, OSB3 sarking, temporary weatherproofing

name: Roof Covering — Slate & Lead Flashing
notes: Natural Welsh slate, code 4 lead valleys/flashings, code 5 parapet caps

name: External Windows & Doors — Supply & Fix
notes: 52 No. softwood casement windows, 8 No. external doors, double-glazed, factory primed

name: External Render & Insulated Cladding
input_materials: EPS 100mm Board, Render Base Coat, Silicone Topcoat
notes: EWI 100mm EPS, mesh-reinforced basecoat, silicone render finish

name: Roof Insulation & Air Tightness
notes: 400mm blown mineral wool to roof void, VCL to ceiling level, airtightness taping

name: External Landscaping — Phase 1 Enabling
notes: Sub-base for paths and parking, topsoil strip and retain, boundary fencing

name: 1st Fix Plumbing — Pipework & Waste
notes: HW/CW distribution to all apartments, soil stacks, MVHR ductwork routes

name: 1st Fix Electrical — Containment & Wiring
input_materials: 2.5mm T&E Cable, 4mm Ring Main Cable, Conduit
notes: Sub-mains, ring mains, lighting circuits, data/TV containment, EV charger routes

name: Thermal & Acoustic Insulation — Floors & Partitions
notes: 60mm acoustic quilt between floors, 100mm Rockwool to party walls, VCL

name: Internal Blockwork Partitions
notes: 100mm dense block partitions to all apartments, lintels over openings

name: Plasterboard Dry Lining & Ceilings
notes: Metal stud lining, 12.5mm board, 15mm FB to ceilings, taped and jointed

name: Wet Plaster Skim & Finish
notes: 2mm finish skim to all plasterboard, set and polish to 3mm tolerance

name: 2nd Fix Plumbing — Sanitaryware & Commissioning
input_materials: Sanitaryware, Basin Mixers, Shower Valves, Radiators
notes: Sanitaryware fit, radiators, pressure test to 1.5 bar, commissioning

name: 2nd Fix Electrical — Faceplates & Testing
input_materials: Sockets, Switches, Light Fittings, Consumer Unit
notes: Faceplates, consumer units, EV chargers, EICR testing, commissioning

name: Kitchen & Bathroom Fit-Out
input_materials: Kitchen Units, Worktops, Tiles, Sanitary Ware
notes: 24 apartments: kitchen units, worktops, tiling, bathroom suites

name: Decoration — Internal Paint & Finishes
notes: Mist coat + 2 coats emulsion, gloss to all joinery, sealant to junctions

name: Building Control Inspection & Sign-Off
notes: Final Building Control inspection, commissioning certificates, EPC
